policy: Sources inform XR Foundry governance decisions but do not transfer their roles, permission models, licenses, brands, tokens, wallets, social channels, or runtime authority.

sources.title: RFC 0001: Agent Commons V1
adopted_lessons: Human GitHub identity is the accountable authority boundary.
Task claims and public input grant no repository permission.
limits: The RFC does not define a progressive governance maturity path.
excluded_assumptions: Agent identity or task participation creates independent authority.

sources.title: RFC 0002: Public Workbench and Contribution Recognition V1
adopted_lessons: Contribution evidence, acknowledgement, and revocable permission are separate ledgers.
Activity, rankings, points, and token counts do not grant authority.
limits: The proposed workbench does not itself activate a DAO or treasury.
excluded_assumptions: Contribution volume is an automatic role-promotion rule.

sources.title: Public deliberation protocol V1
adopted_lessons: Deliberation, synthesis, decision, and execution are separate layers.
Only a resolved record plus a separate Task Hall checkpoint can make work ready.
limits: A deliberation record grants no repository or execution permission.
excluded_assumptions: A new governance system needs a parallel proposal or voting database.

sources.title: Repository roles for an organization
adopted_lessons: Repository permission is an explicit platform role, not an inferred contribution property.
limits: GitHub role capability does not authorize XR Foundry to create an organization or change a role.
excluded_assumptions: Naming a future steward in an RFC grants that GitHub role.

sources.title: About code owners
adopted_lessons: CODEOWNERS routes review and can participate in separately configured protection rules.
limits: A CODEOWNERS entry does not itself grant repository permission or enable required approval.
excluded_assumptions: Editing CODEOWNERS alone changes the live repository role topology.

sources.title: Roles and responsibilities
adopted_lessons: Broader project responsibility benefits from explicit duties and increasing trust.
limits: XR Foundry defines its own roles, evidence, scale, and maintainer decisions.
excluded_assumptions: Kubernetes membership, reviewer, approver, bot, or organization policy transfers to XR Foundry.

sources.title: Folo repository at reviewed commit 465b997e89bde007fcac32257baec6a2ded73164
adopted_lessons: A mature open product can combine a core team with community-maintained distribution routes.
Contributor-facing release notes and clear contribution funnels can strengthen public adoption.
limits: The reviewed repository is not used as a DAO decision or repository-authority precedent.
Community adaptation and distribution registration is deferred until phase two has real evidence.
excluded_assumptions: Folo wallet, POWER/RSS3, license, brand, social channels, mutable action references, credentials, or release-branch topology should be copied.
